title: FelixCraft
description: modpack for small servers, focused on technology
body:
FelixCraft is a Forge 1.20.1 modpack focused on technology, automation, quality‑of‑life improvements, and smooth cooperative gameplay.

It combines reliable QoL mods, protection systems, travel utilities, and a set of Create add‑ons that let you build complex factories and fully automated production lines.

Core Features
Create + add‑ons:

Create Factory Logistics

Create Enchantment Industry

Create Fully Automated

Create Vintage

SecurityCraft – advanced base protection and security systems.

Traveller’s Backpack – expanded inventory and mobility.

JEI – clean recipe browsing and item lookup.

Carry On – move blocks and entities with ease.

Corpse – keeps your items safe after death.

JourneyMap – a live world map for exploration.

Waystones – fast travel between discovered locations.

Odyssey Claims & Odyssey Allies – land claiming and team management.

Jade – detailed block and entity information.

Freecam – free camera for building and overview.

FelixCraft is designed to be stable, intuitive, and ideal for server play with friends.
Perfect for players who want to build, automate, and create without unnecessary complexity.
